AckRequest.description: The body of a "mark as read": the empty JSON object.
AckRequest.title: AckRequest

BulkAckOut.description: How many alerts a bulk mark-as-read changed; 0 for another user's or an unknown run.
BulkAckOut.title: BulkAckOut

BulkAckRequest.description: The body of marking a run's low-priority alerts read: the run's id.
BulkAckRequest.title: BulkAckRequest

CoralError.description: What was refused: a stable ``code``, a message for people, and machine-readable details.
CoralError.title: CoralError

CoralErrorResponse.description: The body of every Coral refusal.
CoralErrorResponse.title: CoralErrorResponse

EmptyRequest.description: The body of an action that takes no arguments: the empty JSON object.
EmptyRequest.title: EmptyRequest

EntryFrame.description: One run-log row without its body; ``patch`` is the stored view patch, or empty.
EntryFrame.title: EntryFrame

GateAnswerOut.description: A taken answer; ``duplicate`` when the same answer was taken before.
GateAnswerOut.title: GateAnswerOut

GateAnswerRequest.description: An answer to one visit of a gate: the visit's token, the chosen outcome and a note.
GateAnswerRequest.title: GateAnswerRequest

GateOut.description:
A gate visit waiting for its answer. ``context`` is what its approval prompt asks;
``None`` when the run's engine state cannot be loaded or does not hold the visit.
GateOut.title: GateOut

InvalidResult.description: A workflow document that did not load.
InvalidResult.title: InvalidResult

JoinInfo.description: How a node with several incoming arrows combines them.
JoinInfo.title: JoinInfo

JsonPatch.description: One JSON Patch operation addressed by a JSON pointer.
JsonPatch.title: JsonPatch

LabelSet.description: Labels on the label-selected outgoing arrows of a node.
LabelSet.title: LabelSet

LoadError.description: A document that could not be loaded; ``issues`` lists every schema error.
LoadError.title: LoadError

LogEntryOut.description:
One run-log row with its body: the stream's entry frame plus ``body``. ``body`` is
``None`` for a row that cannot be read (``kind`` ``log.unreadable``) and, with
``body_truncated``, for a body too large to send. ``actor_kind`` is ``None`` only on
such a row, for a code this server does not know.
LogEntryOut.title: LogEntryOut

LogPage.description: Log rows in ``seq`` order; ``next_after_seq`` is set when more rows follow.
LogPage.title: LogPage

LoopInfo.description: A loop closed by one back-arrow.
LoopInfo.title: LoopInfo

OutcomeCheckout.description:
How to check out a run's branch: ``command`` moves the repository's main checkout to
the branch tip (detached), ``worktree_command`` opens the run's worktree. Both are
``None`` with ``unavailable`` set when no safe command can be built.
OutcomeCheckout.title: OutcomeCheckout

OutcomeDiff.description:
What a run changed, from ``from_commit`` (its base) to ``to_commit`` (its head when
read). The counts cover the whole diff; ``paths`` holds at most 100 sorted paths,
each shown with backslashes and unsafe or invisible characters as ``\u{XXXX}`` and
cut at 512 characters, and ``paths_truncated`` says whether the host or the server
cut it.
OutcomeDiff.title: OutcomeDiff

PreflightEstimate.description: How many sessions a one-pass start of this workflow needs; no spend history yet.
PreflightEstimate.title: PreflightEstimate

PreflightFix.description: One named fix for a failed preflight check.
PreflightFix.title: PreflightFix

PreflightItemOut.description: One preflight check and its result.
PreflightItemOut.title: PreflightItemOut

PreflightRequest.description:
A preflight of one of the caller's workflows on a host, without starting a run.

``host_id`` names the host whose readiness and OS sandbox are checked; no
worktree is created.
PreflightRequest.title: PreflightRequest

PreflightResponse.description: HRN-02's preflight report plus a session-count estimate.
PreflightResponse.title: PreflightResponse

Problem.description: One finding, anchored to nodes, arrows and a ``yaml_path``.
Problem.title: Problem

ProfileDetailOut.description: A user profile with its latest spec and every revision, newest first.
ProfileDetailOut.title: ProfileDetailOut

ProfileRowOut.description: One profile as the desk lists it; a seeded row is a built-in stance, read-only.
ProfileRowOut.title: ProfileRowOut

ProfileSpec.description: The content of one profile revision; immutable once saved.
ProfileSpec.title: ProfileSpec

Region.description: Parallel region between an unlabelled split and its AND-join.
Region.title: Region

RequiredCommand.description:
One command that must pass after the step's last change.

:param run: One plain command, e.g. ``pytest -q``, matched as the last command
    of an ``&&`` chain (``coral.evidence.match``).
:param may_modify: The command may change the tree (a formatter); its own
    changes do not count as the step's last change when it runs on its own.
:param allow_args: A run may add arguments after ``run``; by default the
    argv must be exactly ``run``'s.
RequiredCommand.title: RequiredCommand

ResumeRequest.description: A resume; ``cap`` raises the activation cap of a run paused at it.
ResumeRequest.title: ResumeRequest

ResyncFrame.description: The cursor cannot be replayed; a fresh ``snapshot`` follows.
ResyncFrame.title: ResyncFrame

base_revision_no.description: The revision the edit started from.
base_revision_no.title: Base Revision No

RuleInstance.description: One catalog template attached to a profile, with params checked against the template.
RuleInstance.title: RuleInstance

RuleStrength.description: Required rules are enforced by a guardrail policy; Guidance rules are instructions.
RuleStrength.title: RuleStrength

RunDetail.description:
One run in full. ``view`` is ``None`` and ``load_error`` is set for a run that
cannot be loaded; ``target``, ``max_activations`` and ``request_preview`` are
``None`` when its stored rows cannot be read. ``retry_activation_ids`` are the store
ids of the failed steps a retry may restart now, in cause order: none while the run
is not paused or a host hold or a restart stands.
RunDetail.title: RunDetail

RunFrame.description: The run header again, sent when the row changes without a view patch.
RunFrame.title: RunFrame

RunHeader.description: The run row as clients see it; a finished row wins over what the view says.
RunHeader.title: RunHeader

RunOutcome.description:
What one of the caller's runs produced and how to check it out.

Exactly one of ``diff`` and ``diff_unavailable`` is set. ``branch`` and the host
fields are ``None`` when the run has no worktree of its own; the two paths are also
``None`` when no command could be built for them. ``head_commit`` is the branch tip
the host reported now.
RunOutcome.title: RunOutcome

RunPage.description: One page of runs, newest first; page again with ``next_cursor`` until it is null.
RunPage.title: RunPage

RunSpend.description:
What a run has spent so far, as last read: shown, never capped.

``usd`` is the display figure its anchor's badge shows, ``live_usd`` includes
spend still in flight; both are ``None`` when no session was priced and a lower
bound when ``unpriced_models`` is not empty. ``as_of`` is when it was read.
RunSpend.title: RunSpend

RunSpendTokens.description: Tokens a run's sessions used, summed over its whole session tree.
RunSpendTokens.title: RunSpendTokens

RunSummary.description: A run as its owner's run list shows it; ``run_branch`` is derived from its id.
RunSummary.title: RunSummary

RunTarget.description: Where the run works: its host, repository and worktree branch.
RunTarget.title: RunTarget

SavedWorkflowOut.description: The definition a save stored, with the validation of what was saved.
SavedWorkflowOut.title: SavedWorkflowOut

SlotOut.description:
An agent slot of one of the run's steps. ``slot_id`` and ``activation_id`` are store
ids; ``engine_slot_id`` is the id the run view's slots carry.
SlotOut.title: SlotOut

SnapshotFrame.description: The whole view at head ``seq``; ``view`` is ``None`` only for a run that cannot load.
SnapshotFrame.title: SnapshotFrame

SourceRange.description: 1-based inclusive start, exclusive end positions in the YAML text.
SourceRange.title: SourceRange

StartRunRequest.description:
A start of one of the caller's workflows on their host's repository.

``start_key`` makes the start idempotent: the same key and request answer the run
it started, another request with the key is a conflict. ``title`` defaults to the
workflow's name; ``base_ref`` to the repository's checked-out head.
StartRunRequest.title: StartRunRequest

UnresolvedFact.description: Something Analysis could not resolve; blocks running the workflow.
UnresolvedFact.title: UnresolvedFact

ValidResult.description: A workflow that loaded and compiled, with what validation found.
ValidResult.title: ValidResult

WorkflowAlertOut.description: One open alert as the Inbox lists it: its row's fields merged with its payload.
WorkflowAlertOut.title: WorkflowAlertOut

WorkflowDetailOut.description: A stored workflow definition with its YAML and compiled graph.
WorkflowDetailOut.title: WorkflowDetailOut

WorkflowInboxPage.description:
One feed page. A page can be empty and still carry ``next_cursor``: keep paging
until it is null.
WorkflowInboxPage.title: WorkflowInboxPage

WorkflowSummaryOut.description: A stored workflow definition as lists show it.
WorkflowSummaryOut.title: WorkflowSummaryOut

WorkflowYaml.description: A workflow document as YAML text.
WorkflowYaml.title: WorkflowYaml

get.description: The caller's open alerts: normal priority first, newest first within each.

post.description:
Mark the caller's open low-priority alerts of one run read, as opening the run
does. Alerts that ask for an action or an answer stay open.
Mark one of the caller's alerts read; marking it again changes nothing.

get.description: Report whether Coral is enabled on this server and its sub-feature map.
The built-in stances, then the caller's profiles by ref.
One of the caller's profiles with its spec and revisions.

post.description: Save an edit as the next revision; unchanged content keeps the latest one.

get.description: Every rule template a profile can use, with its params schema and bypasses.
The caller's runs, newest first; spend is what the cache holds, or null.

post.description:
Start one of the caller's workflows on their host's repository: 201 with the new
run, or 200 with the run the same ``start_key`` and request started before.

200.description: The run this start key already started, for the same request

get.description: One of the caller's runs in full, with its spend so far.

post.description:
Retry a failed step of one of the caller's runs: its old session is fenced and its
work saved while the run stays paused, then a new session starts it again.

Answer a visit of one of the caller's run's gates with one of its outcomes, as
its prompt would be answered. A visit the run does not have is the run 404.

get.description: The workflow graph the run is pinned to; ``If-None-Match`` revalidates it.

The run's log rows after ``after_seq``, with their bodies: at most 1 MiB of bodies
and patches a page, then ``next_after_seq``. A body over 256 KiB is left out.

What one of the caller's runs produced: its branch, the commands that check it
out, and for a finished run its diff from its base commit, read through its host.
A diff that cannot be read is answered with ``diff_unavailable``, never an error.

Follow one of the caller's runs: a snapshot of its view, then one entry per log
row with the row's view patch. ``Last-Event-ID`` (else ``after_seq``) resumes
after the last seq the client holds. A stream ends after five minutes; the
client resumes from its last seq. Past the stream caps, poll ``/log`` instead.

200.description: Server-sent events: each event's data is a RunStreamFrame, or `[DONE]` once a finished run's rows are all sent

post.description: Cancel one of the caller's runs; a cancelled run is left as it is.
Pause one of the caller's runs; a paused run is left as it is.

Resume one of the caller's paused runs; ``cap`` raises the activation cap of one
paused at it. A run not paused is left as it is.

Check whether one of the caller's workflows can start on their host, without
starting a run: auth, host, OS sandbox and system Claude, plus a session estimate.
Store the caller's workflow under its key, replacing their earlier version.

get.description: One of the caller's workflows with its YAML and compiled graph.

post.description: Load, compile and validate a workflow without storing it.
